{* Code generated by @ui8kit/codegen. DO NOT EDIT. *}
{* Select — Select renders option children from Options, then manual children. *}
{parameters
  string $class = '',
  ?string $id = null,
  ?string $name = null,
  string $value = '',
  bool $multiple = false,
  bool $required = false,
  bool $disabled = false,
  array $options = [],
  ?string $ariaInvalid = null,
  ?string $ariaDescribedBy = null,
  array $attrs = [],
  string $children = '',
}
<select n:attr="[
  'class' => \UI8Kit\Latte\Rt::orNull(\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::selectClasses(['class' => $class, 'id' => $id, 'name' => $name, 'value' => $value, 'multiple' => $multiple, 'required' => $required, 'disabled' => $disabled, 'ariaInvalid' => $ariaInvalid, 'ariaDescribedBy' => $ariaDescribedBy])),
  'id' => \UI8Kit\Latte\Rt::orNull($id),
  'name' => \UI8Kit\Latte\Rt::orNull($name),
  'multiple' => $multiple,
  'required' => $required,
  'disabled' => $disabled,
  'aria-invalid' => \UI8Kit\Latte\Rt::orNull($ariaInvalid),
  'aria-describedby' => \UI8Kit\Latte\Rt::orNull($ariaDescribedBy),
  ...\UI8Kit\Latte\Rt::restAttrs($attrs, false, ['id', 'name', 'aria-invalid', 'aria-describedby']),
]">{foreach $options as $item}<option n:attr="[
  'value' => ($item['value'] ?? ''),
  'selected' => (($item['value'] ?? '') === $value),
  'disabled' => ($item['disabled'] ?? false),
]">{=($item['label'] ?? '')}</option>{/foreach}{$children|noescape}</select>

{* Code generated by @ui8kit/codegen. DO NOT EDIT. *}
{* SelectOption — SelectOption renders a native option. *}
{parameters
  ?string $value = null,
  bool $selected = false,
  bool $disabled = false,
  array $attrs = [],
  string $children = '',
}
<option n:attr="[
  'value' => $value,
  'selected' => $selected,
  'disabled' => $disabled,
  ...\UI8Kit\Latte\Rt::restAttrs($attrs),
]">{$children|noescape}</option>
